summary: Londian Wason New Energy Tech Inc. filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing the closing of the partial exercise of the underwriters' over-allotment option from its US IPO, selling an additional 626,104 ADSs at $22.00 per ADS. Aggregate gross proceeds reached $108,059,996, comprising $94,285,708 from the base IPO and the balance from the option. Underwriters were represented by Cantor Fitzgerald, Huatai Securities (USA), CMB International and US Tiger Securities; Davis Polk and Cleary Gottlieb acted as counsel. This is a routine IPO over-allotment closing, not a special situation; watch post-IPO lock-up expiry and share overhang.
